text:
1/ ⚡ LIVE MARKET (15 tools, ~1–3 min delay)

– Stock quote: LTP, OHLC, volume, 52W
– Index quote: NIFTY, BANK, VIX + 1W/1M/1Y
– ~140 live indices by group
– Top gainers & losers (All, NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, NEXT50)
– Live lists: equity, SME, bonds, call auction
– Data freshness check

2/ 📊 END-OF-DAY: STOCKS (5 yrs data)

– Daily OHLCV + close on any date
– Bulk quote, up to 50 symbols
– 52W high/low
– Moving averages (20/50/200)
– Volume spikes & trend
– Splits, bonuses, dividends
– Symbol search
– Compare up to 10 stocks
– Stock vs index: beta, correlation

3/ 🏛 END-OF-DAY: MARKET & INDICES

– Mood: VIX, advances vs declines
– Breadth: A/D ratio, volume
– Top movers & most active by date
– ~170 indices: OHLC, P/E, P/B
– Index history, returns 1D–2Y
– Valuation vs past 5 yrs
– Compare up to 10 indices: return, volatility, drawdown
Cash market only, no F&O or intraday candles. For info/education, not investment advice.
any rate limit on the live quotes?

NSE hasn\'t published a rate limit, and there are no rate-limit headers. It sits behind Akamai though, so heavy bursts can get a client stalled for a few minutes. Live data only refreshes about once a minute anyway, so caching and polling gently works best.
